symptom: 5 epoch route_recovery auxiliary staged behavior clone with entropy_regularization 0.08 survived the 5 second toy load smoke but selected action 3 on 151/151 frames, producing zero action entropy.
root_cause: Increasing supervised epochs and entropy regularization improved offline validation metrics but did not repair deterministic low entropy in online evaluation. Follow-up offline diagnostics show the full mixed dataset does not globally collapse, an absolute-time conditioning fix did not remove the 5 second action 3 loop, and nearest-neighbor comparison against same-map 0-60 second opening samples found 147/151 nearest teacher targets are also action 3. The short smoke is therefore likely sitting inside a very narrow opening teacher neighborhood; remaining risk is whether the policy history can transition into recovery actions after that opening segment.
fix: Keep this checkpoint as repair evidence only. Absolute-time conditioning is now internally consistent, but this checkpoint still needs longer-window trace/dataset diagnostics or explicit history/recovery constraints before any policy promotion.
validation: Recorded in harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_entropy_retry_001/evaluation_5s_soda.json and harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_absolute_time_conditioning_fix_001/evaluation_5s_soda.json; both keep action 3 ratio 1.0 with low_action_entropy and gate_decision evaluation_recorded_needs_action_bias_repair. Follow-up nearest-neighbor evidence is in harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_absolute_time_conditioning_fix_001/trace_dataset_nearest_opening.json with nearest_target_matches_online_action_ratio 0.9735.
